title: 溢洪道氣蝕防治~Cavitation mitigation in spillways
focus: 由絕對壓力缺陷含氣與修補驗證氣蝕防治~Verifying cavitation mitigation through absolute pressure defects aeration and repair
summary: 本課以由絕對壓力缺陷含氣與修補驗證氣蝕防治為主線，先用絕對壓力與蒸氣壓與氣蝕指標與速度界定水力與構造條件，再將摻氣量與相分率、拋離空腔與再附著連結到運轉曝露與追蹤。氣蝕指標與含氣算例只作機制比較，起蝕門檻依表面幾何水質與流況而變。 每單元以原創算例、量測與失效辨識共同檢查推論。~This course develops verifying cavitation mitigation through absolute pressure defects aeration and repair through Absolute pressure and vapor pressure and Cavitation index and velocity, then connects Air supply and phase fraction and Jet cavity and reattachment to Operating exposure and follow-up. Cavitation indices and aeration examples compare mechanisms; inception thresholds depend on surface geometry water quality and flow conditions. Each unit combines original calculation, measurement and failure diagnosis to test the inference.
history: 本課所研究的由絕對壓力缺陷含氣與修補驗證氣蝕防治，反映水工設計由單一尺寸選取走向水流、材料、施工與長期監測共同驗證的發展。氣蝕指標與含氣算例只作機制比較，起蝕門檻依表面幾何水質與流況而變。 美國墾務局官方目錄列有1978年消能工專論、1980年水力試驗技術及1987年小壩設計，這些是技術文件出版年份，不是本課假想工程的啟用日期。所列具名工程只供公開原理與邊界比較，不主張取得其設計圖、現場紀錄或專有參數。~The focus on verifying cavitation mitigation through absolute pressure defects aeration and repair reflects development from isolated sizing toward joint verification of flow, materials, construction and long-term observations. Cavitation indices and aeration examples compare mechanisms; inception thresholds depend on surface geometry water quality and flow conditions. The Reclamation catalog lists the 1978 energy-dissipator monograph, 1980 hydraulic laboratory techniques and 1987 small-dam manual. These are publication dates, not commissioning dates for a hypothetical project. Named works support comparisons of public principles and boundaries; this course claims no access to proprietary drawings, field records or project parameters.
example: 整合算例輸入全為教學假設，先檢查絕對壓力與蒸氣壓：atmosphericPressure=90 kPa; gaugePressure=-35 kPa; absolutePressure=90-35=55 kPa；再獨立檢查氣蝕指標與速度：pAbsolute=100 kPa; pVapor=2.3 kPa; rho=1000 kg/m3; V=20 m/s; sigma=(100000-2300)/(0.5*1000*20**2)=0.4885。敏感度：絕對壓力100kPa與蒸氣壓2.3kPa不變，速度由20增至30m/s，氣蝕指標由0.4885降至0.2171；速度增加50%使動壓增加125%，但不能由指標直接預報破壞速率。 兩個結果須按各自量綱解釋，不能直接相加或當成完整設計。氣蝕指標與含氣算例只作機制比較，起蝕門檻依表面幾何水質與流況而變。 將用重複三維掃描比較凹坑位置體積並保留運轉流量紀錄作為獨立驗證，明確列出尚缺的現地輸入及其對結論的影響。~Every input in this integrated example is a teaching assumption. First examine Absolute pressure and vapor pressure: atmosphericPressure=90 kPa; gaugePressure=-35 kPa; absolutePressure=90-35=55 kPa. Independently examine Cavitation index and velocity: pAbsolute=100 kPa; pVapor=2.3 kPa; rho=1000 kg/m3; V=20 m/s; sigma=(100000-2300)/(0.5*1000*20**2)=0.4885. Sensitivity: holding absolute pressure at100kPa and vapor pressure at2.3kPa, increasing speed from20 to30m/s lowers the index from0.4885 to0.2171. Dynamic pressure increases125 percent, but the index alone does not predict damage rate. Interpret each result in its own dimensions rather than adding them or treating them as a complete design. Cavitation indices and aeration examples compare mechanisms; inception thresholds depend on surface geometry water quality and flow conditions. Use the following independent check: Compare repeated three-dimensional pit maps and volumes against operating discharge records. Identify missing field inputs and state which conclusions depend on them.

units.anchor: 絕對壓力與蒸氣壓~Absolute pressure and vapor pressure
units.title: 絕對壓力與蒸氣壓~Absolute pressure and vapor pressure
units.mechanism: 氣蝕涉及局部壓力接近液體蒸氣壓，兩者必須使用相同絕對壓力基準。高程與天氣會改變大氣壓，水溫則改變蒸氣壓；把表壓直接相減會嚴重錯估餘量。量測時須記錄壓力校正與溫度，而非只報單一負壓數值。 驗證時應將氣壓計與壓力感測器零點校正對齊並記錄水溫，並辨識以下失效情境：混用表壓與絕對壓會錯估距離氣化條件的餘量。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Cavitation concerns local pressure approaching vapor pressure, both on an absolute basis. Altitude and weather affect atmospheric pressure while temperature affects vapor pressure. Subtracting gauge pressure directly gives the wrong margin; record pressure calibration and temperature instead of reporting only one negative gauge value. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Align barometer and pressure-sensor zero checks and record water temperature. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Mixing gauge and absolute pressure misstates the margin to vapor formation. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
units.model: 原創教學假設：atmosphericPressure=90 kPa; gaugePressure=-35 kPa; absolutePressure=90-35=55 kPa。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: atmosphericPressure=90 kPa; gaugePressure=-35 kPa; absolutePressure=90-35=55 kPa. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.
units.verify: 將氣壓計與壓力感測器零點校正對齊並記錄水溫。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「混用表壓與絕對壓會錯估距離氣化條件的餘量」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。~Align barometer and pressure-sensor zero checks and record water temperature. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Mixing gauge and absolute pressure misstates the margin to vapor formation. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted.
units.failure: 混用表壓與絕對壓會錯估距離氣化條件的餘量。診斷時應採取以下查核：將氣壓計與壓力感測器零點校正對齊並記錄水溫，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。~Mixing gauge and absolute pressure misstates the margin to vapor formation. Diagnose it by the following check: Align barometer and pressure-sensor zero checks and record water temperature. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.
units.misconception: 表壓負值就表示液體一定已達蒸氣壓~Any negative gauge pressure proves that liquid has reached vapor pressure
units.practice: 交接時以將氣壓計與壓力感測器零點校正對齊並記錄水溫作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對混用表壓與絕對壓會錯估距離氣化條件的餘量，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。~At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Align barometer and pressure-sensor zero checks and record water temperature. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Mixing gauge and absolute pressure misstates the margin to vapor formation. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

units.anchor: 氣蝕指標與速度~Cavitation index and velocity
units.title: 氣蝕指標與速度~Cavitation index and velocity
units.mechanism: 氣蝕指標把高於蒸氣壓的壓力餘量除以參考動壓，可比較局部低壓對高速水流的相對程度。分母速度必須與起蝕資料使用相同定義；指標不是破壞速率，表面不平整、氣核與含氣保護仍會改變實際結果。 驗證時應同步量測參考速度與局部壓力並標明指標定義，並辨識以下失效情境：採不同位置速度比較門檻會造成不一致判讀。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~The cavitation index normalizes pressure margin above vapor pressure by a reference dynamic pressure. Its velocity definition must match the inception data used for comparison. The index is not a damage-rate law; surface irregularities, nuclei and protective aeration still affect the physical outcome. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure reference velocity and local pressure together and state the index definition. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Using velocities from different reference locations makes threshold comparisons inconsistent. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
units.model: 原創教學假設：pAbsolute=100 kPa; pVapor=2.3 kPa; rho=1000 kg/m3; V=20 m/s; sigma=(100000-2300)/(0.5*1000*20**2)=0.4885。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: pAbsolute=100 kPa; pVapor=2.3 kPa; rho=1000 kg/m3; V=20 m/s; sigma=(100000-2300)/(0.5*1000*20**2)=0.4885. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Using velocities from different reference locations makes threshold comparisons inconsistent. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

units.anchor: 錯台尺度與流動分離~Offset scale and separation
units.title: 錯台尺度與流動分離~Offset scale and separation
units.mechanism: 迎流錯台使水流突然偏轉，背後低壓與渦流可能觸發氣蝕；缺陷方向和尖銳程度比單純高度更重要。相對粗糙度可描述尺度但不能提供通用允收值，施工驗收須保留沿流方向的剖面及表面修整紀錄。 驗證時應用沿流剖面儀量測錯台方向高度與前後坡度，並辨識以下失效情境：只量垂直高度會漏掉尖銳迎流邊緣的分離效應。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~An upstream-facing offset abruptly deflects flow and creates low pressure and vortices behind it. Orientation and sharpness matter alongside height. Relative roughness describes scale but is not a universal tolerance; acceptance needs profiles along the flow direction and documented surface finishing. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Profile the surface along flow to measure offset direction, height and adjoining slopes. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Measuring height alone misses separation at a sharp upstream-facing edge. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
units.model: 原創教學假設：offsetHeight=0.004 m; localFlowDepth=0.80 m; relativeOffset=0.004/0.80=0.005 dimensionless。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: offsetHeight=0.004 m; localFlowDepth=0.80 m; relativeOffset=0.004/0.80=0.005 dimensionless. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Measuring height alone misses separation at a sharp upstream-facing edge. units.anchor: 低壓脈動與極值~Low-pressure fluctuations and extremes
units.title: 低壓脈動與極值~Low-pressure fluctuations and extremes
units.mechanism: 平均壓力高於蒸氣壓不表示所有瞬間都安全，紊流脈動可能產生短暫低壓。高斯近似可示範統計尾部但未必適用實際尖峰；應保存原始高頻資料並分析持續時間、空間相關與感測器頻率響應，避免只用平均值判讀。 驗證時應檢查低壓事件的持續時間與相鄰測點是否同步，並辨識以下失效情境：將均值減三倍標準差當絕對下限會漏掉非高斯尖峰。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~A mean above vapor pressure does not exclude brief low-pressure excursions. A Gaussian illustration describes a statistical tail but may not fit actual spikes. Preserve high-rate records and analyze duration, spatial correlation and sensor response rather than judging the condition from the average alone. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Examine excursion duration and synchronization between neighboring pressure sensors. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Treating mean minus three deviations as a hard minimum misses non-Gaussian spikes. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
units.model: 原創教學假設：Illustrative meanAbsolutePressure=70 kPa; standardDeviation=15 kPa; meanMinus3SD=70-3*15=25 kPa; no physical minimum implied。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: Illustrative meanAbsolutePressure=70 kPa; standardDeviation=15 kPa; meanMinus3SD=70-3*15=25 kPa; no physical minimum implied. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

units.anchor: 摻氣量與相分率~Air supply and phase fraction
units.title: 摻氣量與相分率~Air supply and phase fraction
units.mechanism: 供氣可緩和氣泡潰滅附近的局部壓力衝擊，但入口總氣量不等於近壁保護濃度。水氣體積比需以相同壓力溫度定義，並區分氣水比與混合物空隙率；氣泡滑移與沿程脫氣使兩者的空間分布更複雜。 驗證時應同步量測供氣管流量與底部含氣剖面並標記壓力溫度，並辨識以下失效情境：總供氣量正常但氣泡浮離底部仍可能缺乏保護。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Air supply can cushion local collapse pressures, but total supplied air is not near-wall protective concentration. Use consistent pressure and temperature and distinguish air-to-water volume ratio from mixture void fraction. Bubble slip and downstream detrainment complicate the spatial distribution further. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure vent supply and near-bed air profiles together with pressure and temperature. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Normal total supply can coexist with poor protection when bubbles leave the bed. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
units.model: 原創教學假設：Qa=6 m3/s andQw=54 m3/s at common conditions; bulkVoidFraction=6/(6+54)=0.10。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。~Original teaching assumptions: Qa=6 m3/s andQw=54 m3/s at common conditions; bulkVoidFraction=6/(6+54)=0.10. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

units.anchor: 通氣管損失與負壓~Vent losses and suction
units.title: 通氣管損失與負壓~Vent losses and suction
units.mechanism: 摻氣槽形成的空腔需透過通氣管補氣，管路阻力會降低空腔壓力並影響射流軌跡。低馬赫數近似可用局部損失估壓差；若壓差大或接近可壓縮限制，必須改用適當氣體流模型，不可直接照搬不可壓縮公式。 驗證時應量測通氣口與空腔壓差並檢查網罩和轉彎阻力，並辨識以下失效情境：通氣入口堵塞可降低供氣並加深空腔負壓。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Aerator cavities draw air through ducts whose resistance changes cavity pressure and jet shape. At low Mach number, a local-loss relation estimates pressure drop. Large pressure differences or compressibility limits require a gas-flow model instead of unconditional use of an incompressible expression. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure inlet-to-cavity pressure drop and inspect screens and bends. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: A blocked vent inlet reduces supply and deepens cavity suction. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

units.anchor: 拋離空腔與再附著~Jet cavity and reattachment
units.title: 拋離空腔與再附著~Jet cavity and reattachment
units.mechanism: 摻氣坎讓水流暫時離開底板並在下方形成供氣空腔，水舌再附著位置影響近壁含氣與局部壓力。水平拋射簡式只估無阻力的中心線，不代表含氣分布；設計需同時檢查空腔是否淹沒與再附著後的保護長度。 驗證時應以影像量測空腔長度並檢查再附著後近壁含氣，並辨識以下失效情境：尾水或水深增大可能淹沒空腔並切斷補氣。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~An aerator ramp lifts flow from the floor and forms an air cavity. Reattachment affects near-wall air and pressure. A horizontal ballistic estimate gives only a drag-free centerline, not concentration. Check cavity drowning and protection downstream of reattachment as separate performance questions. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure cavity length optically and inspect near-wall air downstream of reattachment. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Higher water depth can drown the cavity and interrupt air supply. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

units.anchor: 損傷盤點與體積~Damage mapping and volume
units.title: 損傷盤點與體積~Damage mapping and volume
units.mechanism: 氣蝕損傷可能由局部凹坑成長並改變後續流場，修補前需建立可重複的地形基準。面積乘平均深度只是體積盤點，不能把它當作未來線性損傷率；磨耗、化學侵蝕與鋼筋剝露需分別辨認並追溯操作歷程。 驗證時應用重複三維掃描比較凹坑位置體積並保留運轉流量紀錄，並辨識以下失效情境：以單次平均損傷量線性外推可能漏掉幾何惡化的加速效應。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Cavitation pits can grow and alter subsequent flow. Establish a repeatable surface datum before repair. Area times mean depth estimates lost volume, not a linear future damage rate. Distinguish abrasion, chemical deterioration and exposed reinforcement and relate each to the operating history. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare repeated three-dimensional pit maps and volumes against operating discharge records. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Linear extrapolation from one survey misses acceleration caused by worsening geometry. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

units.anchor: 修補黏結與平整~Repair bond and surface continuity
units.title: 修補黏結與平整~Repair bond and surface continuity
units.mechanism: 修補材料需與基材共同承受水力脈壓及溫度變形，表面平順與黏結完整同樣重要。拉拔試驗只檢查局部黏結樣本，不能證明整片無空鼓；施工記錄應包含基面處理、養護與沿流接縫輪廓，避免修補本身形成新缺陷。 驗證時應結合拉拔位置圖敲測或適用非破壞檢查與表面剖面，並辨識以下失效情境：局部拉拔合格仍可能存在未取樣的空鼓帶。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Repairs must transfer hydraulic pulses and thermal deformation to the substrate. Smoothness and bond continuity both matter. Pull-off tests sample local adhesion and cannot prove an entire patch void-free; document preparation, curing and flowwise joint profiles so the repair does not create another initiating defect. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Combine mapped pull-off locations, suitable void detection and surface profiles. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Passing local pull-off tests can coexist with an unsampled debonded strip. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.

units.anchor: 運轉曝露與追蹤~Operating exposure and follow-up
units.title: 運轉曝露與追蹤~Operating exposure and follow-up
units.mechanism: 氣蝕損傷與高風險工況的持續時間有關，但不同流速與壓力不能以相同小時數直接等價。曝露時數可建立追蹤帳，仍須按流量、水位、含氣與缺陷狀態分組；修補後對照試驗應保持工況可比，才能辨識改善。 驗證時應按流量水位與含氣狀態分組比較修補前後檢測，並辨識以下失效情境：只比較總時數會掩蓋高速度短時工況的不同作用。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。~Damage depends on exposure to adverse conditions, but hours at different pressures and velocities are not equivalent. An exposure ledger supports tracking only when grouped by discharge, stage, aeration and surface condition. Postrepair comparisons need matched states before attributing changes to the repair. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Group inspections by discharge, stage and aeration when comparing before and after repair. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Comparing total hours alone hides the different effects of brief high-speed operation. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
